description.value: Mean Poutine is a family-run gourmet poutine and specialty hot dog chain founded in 2011 by a former BC Lions football player, with origins in Vancouver's Granville entertainment district. The New Westminster location serves a broad menu of creative poutine combinations — from classic Quebec-style to Southern BBQ and Mean Mexicana — alongside a full hot dog lineup, all made with handcrafted recipes and quality ingredients. Indoor seating is available, making it a solid hearty-meal stop for cyclists passing through New Westminster.
